summary_zh: 本页展示了成语“趁火打劫”的标题，配图是一位穿着古装的人物在简陋的环境中休息，旁边有火炉和悬挂的物品，暗示故事背景。

page_text_ocr_zh: 公元前494年，越王勾践被吴王夫差围困，战败投降。为了求夫差放过越国百姓，勾践搬空了越国的宝库，把金银财宝都送给了吴国，还带着自己的夫人和大臣范蠡，一起去吴国给夫差当奴仆。
page_text_en: In 494 BC, King Goujian of Yue was besieged by King Fuchai of Wu and surrendered after defeat. In order to persuade Fuchai to spare the people of Yue, Goujian emptied his kingdom's treasury, gave all the gold and treasures to Wu, and took his wife and minister Fan Li with him to serve as slaves in Wu.
summary_zh: 本页讲述了公元前494年，越王勾践战败后，为求吴王夫差放过百姓，献出所有财宝，并带着夫人和大臣范蠡前往吴国为奴的历史背景。

page_text_ocr_zh: 到了吴国，勾践住的是又低矮又潮湿的石头房子。房子就在夫差父亲的墓旁，因为他是和越国打仗的时候去世的，所以夫差要勾践在这里守陵。
page_text_en: After arriving in Wu, Gou Jian lived in a low and damp stone house. The house was next to the tomb of Fu Chai's father, who had died during the war against Yue. Therefore, Fu Chai made Gou Jian guard the tomb.
summary_zh: 本页描述了越王勾践被俘后在吴国的悲惨处境：他被安排住在低矮潮湿的石头房子里，该房子位于吴王夫差父亲的墓旁，被迫为夫差父亲守陵。

page_text_ocr_zh:
勾践干的是养马的活儿。
每天天不亮，他就要穿着
马夫的破衣服，起床去扫
马厩，挑马粪，还要给夫
差擦洗马鞍和马车。
当夫差出去游玩时，勾践
就得乖乖地为他拿着马鞭，
牵着马。
page_text_en:
Gou Jian was assigned to take care of the horses.
Every day before dawn, he had to wear
the ragged clothes of a stable boy, get up to clean
the stables, carry horse manure, and also wash
the horse saddles and chariots for King Fu Chai.
When King Fu Chai went out for a ride, Gou Jian
had to obediently hold the whip and
lead the horse for him.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了越王勾践在吴国为奴时的屈辱生活，他被迫从事养马的卑微工作，每天天不亮就要打扫马厩、挑马粪、擦洗马具，并在夫差出游时为其牵马持鞭。

page_text_ocr_zh:
他们自己生火做饭。
勾践干活儿的时候，范蠡就出去拾柴，勾践的夫人为他们做饭吃。
夫差派人送过来的粮食里掺着小石子和沙粒，有的还发了霉。他们每天都吃不饱。
page_text_en:
They cooked their own meals by making a fire.
When King Goujian was working, Fan Li would go out to gather firewood, and King Goujian's wife would cook for them.
The grain sent by Fu Chai contained small stones and sand, and some of it had even molded. They never had enough to eat every day.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了越王勾践在吴国为奴期间的艰苦生活：他与范蠡、夫人一起在简陋的石屋旁生火做饭，靠拾柴和少量掺杂石子沙粒的粮食维生，每日食不果腹。

page_text_ocr_zh: 夫差还经常派人来察看。马厩里的马粪扫干净了没有？勾践放马的时候有没有悄悄睡大觉？他们是不是偷偷在背后咒骂自己？他们晚上睡觉的时候，有没有唉声叹气说辛苦？
page_text_en: Fuchai often sent people to check. Were the horse manure in the stables cleaned up? Did Goujian doze off while herding the horses? Are they secretly cursing me behind my back? When they sleep at night, do they sigh and complain about how hard it is?
summary_zh: 本页描绘了吴王夫差对越王勾践的严密监视，通过派人在马厩巡查，怀疑勾践是否偷懒、抱怨或咒骂，展现了勾践在吴国为奴时所承受的屈辱与高压环境。

page_text_ocr_zh: 就这样过了三年，勾践夫妇和范蠡被折磨得面黄肌瘦，哪里还看得出曾经是国君和大臣！吴王夫差没有发现他们背后偷懒说坏话，也觉得他们很可怜，想放他们回越国。吴国的大将军伍子胥急红了眼：“大王，放勾践回越国，就好比放虎归山，难道您要等他复兴越国后，再来攻打我们吴国吗？”夫差听了伍子胥的劝阻，打消了这个念头。
page_text_en: Three years passed, and King Goujian, his wife, and Fan Li were worn down and emaciated, no longer resembling a king and his ministers. King Fu Chai of Wu had not discovered any laziness or slander from them, and felt pity, considering letting them return to Yue. Wu's general Wu Zixu grew furious: "Your Majesty, releasing Goujian back to Yue is like letting a tiger return to the mountains. Do you intend to wait until he revives Yue and then attack us again?" Fu Chai, upon hearing Wu Zixu's advice, abandoned the idea.
summary_zh: 本页讲述了越王勾践在吴国为奴三年后，因表现顺从而被吴王夫差考虑放归，但被大将军伍子胥以“放虎归山”为由劝阻，夫差最终打消了放归念头。

page_text_ocr_zh:
不久，夫差生病了。勾践每天给他端水送药，穿衣脱鞋，还亲自扶他上厕所。等到病好了，夫差又打算放勾践回越国。
伍子胥知道后急忙跑来劝阻。夫差大叫道："我生病的时候，你不但没来看我，连药也没送一包。你看勾践，他连我的大便都肯尝，可见他对我的忠心呀！"很快，夫差就亲自派人送勾践回到了越国。
page_text_en:
Soon, King Fu Chai fell ill. Gou Jian served him water and medicine every day, dressed and undressed him, and even personally helped him to the toilet. After he recovered, Fu Chai planned to send Gou Jian back to Yue.
When Wu Zixu learned of this, he hurried to dissuade him. Fu Chai shouted, "When I was sick, you didn't even come to see me, let alone bring a single packet of medicine. Look at Gou Jian—he even tasted my stool! This proves his loyalty to me!" Soon after, Fu Chai personally sent Gou Jian back to Yue.
summary_zh: 夫差生病时，勾践悉心照料，甚至尝其粪便以示忠诚，夫差因此动容，决定放勾践回国，但伍子胥前来劝阻，夫差最终仍派人送勾践返回越国。

page_text_ocr_zh: 勾践回到越国后，每个月都派人给夫差送礼物。"大王，勾践送来了十颗千年难见的夜明珠。"夫差看着一颗颗光灿灿的夜明珠，赞叹道："如果把它们放在高大宽敞的宫殿里，一定更漂亮！"
page_text_en: After returning to Yue, Goujian sent gifts to King Fuchai every month. "Your Majesty, Goujian has sent ten rare night pearls from a thousand years ago." Fuchai looked at the shining night pearls and exclaimed, "If we place them in a tall and spacious palace, they would surely be even more beautiful!"
summary_zh: 勾践回到越国后，每月派人向吴王夫差进献礼物，此次送来十颗珍贵的夜明珠，夫差对此十分赞赏。

page_text_ocr_zh: 勾践马上派出三千名木工，到深山里砍伐长得又粗又高的千年古树，雕上精美的盘龙花纹，镶金嵌玉，献给了夫差。"这么高大的树木，可以建最富丽堂皇的宫殿呀！" 于是，夫差建起了三百丈高的姑苏台，修宫室，挖河道，造龙舟。这里全年花开不断，四季果实累累。然而，夫差叹息道："美哉美哉，可惜还缺一位美人呀！"
page_text_en: Gou Jian immediately sent out three thousand carpenters to deep mountains to cut down tall, thick, ancient trees, carve them with exquisite dragon patterns, inlay them with gold and jade, and present them to Fu Chai. "Such towering trees can build the most magnificent palace!" Thus, Fu Chai built the 300-zhang-high Gusu Terrace, constructed palaces, dug canals, and built dragon boats. Here, flowers bloomed all year round, and fruits ripened in every season. Yet, Fu Chai sighed, "How beautiful, how beautiful—only one thing is missing: a beautiful woman!"
summary_zh: 勾践为讨好吴王夫差，派遣三千木工砍伐古树，雕饰后献给夫差，夫差因此大兴土木，建造姑苏台等豪华建筑，但感叹缺少美人。

page_text_ocr_zh: 勾践听说后，又在越国挑选出两名美女——西施和郑旦，送到了吴国。这两位美女都有沉鱼落雁之容，闭月羞花之貌。
page_text_en: After hearing this, King Goujian selected two beautiful women from Yue—Xi Shi and Zheng Dan—and sent them to Wu. These two women were of such beauty that they could make fish sink, geese fall, the moon hide, and flowers blush.
summary_zh: 勾践为讨好吴王夫差，挑选越国美女西施和郑旦送往吴国，以示臣服与献媚。

page_text_ocr_zh:
在夫差兴修宫殿、游山玩水的时候，回到越国的勾践却在卧薪尝胆。
勾践回国后，没有住高大华丽的宫殿，也没有睡绵软舒适的大床。他修了一间跟在吴国时住的一样的石头房子，用柴草当被褥。他还在房里挂了一个苦胆，每天吃饭前都要尝一尝它的苦味，好叫自己不要忘记战败的耻辱。
page_text_en:
While King Fuchai was building palaces and enjoying mountain tours, King Goujian, back in Yue, was sleeping on firewood and tasting gall.
After returning to Yue, Goujian did not live in a grand palace or sleep on a soft, comfortable bed. He built a stone house just like the one he lived in in Wu, using firewood and straw as bedding. He also hung a bitter gallbladder in his room, tasting its bitterness before every meal, to remind himself never to forget the shame of defeat.
summary_zh: 勾践回国后，为不忘战败之耻，选择住简陋石屋、睡柴草、每日尝苦胆，以自励图强。

page_text_ocr_zh:
他穿上粗布衣服，跟百姓一起耕田播种。他的夫人就带领妇女们养蚕织布。
他奖赏生孩子的父母，生男孩就奖励两壶酒、一条狗，生女孩就奖励两壶酒、一头猪。
他训练士兵，让军队变得勇猛无敌。
page_text_en:
He wore rough cloth clothes and plowed and sowed the fields together with the common people. His wife led the women to raise silkworms and weave cloth.
He rewarded parents who gave birth to children: for a boy, two jars of wine and a dog; for a girl, two jars of wine and a pig.
He trained soldiers, making the army brave and invincible.
summary_zh: 勾践回国后，与百姓同甘共苦，亲自耕田，夫人带领妇女养蚕织布，同时奖赏生育、训练军队，励精图治，为复国做准备。

page_text_ocr_zh:
他赠送木料给吴王，
要让他耗费吴国的人力和财力去造宫殿。
他进献美人给吴王，
要让他荒废政事。
可是，吴国还有一位能征善战的大将军伍子胥，有他领兵打仗，
吴国的军队还是很强大，怎么办呢？
page_text_en:
He sent timber to King Wu, 
intending to make him spend the manpower and wealth of Wu on building palaces. 
He presented beautiful women to King Wu, 
intending to make him neglect state affairs. 
However, Wu still had a great general, Wu Zixu, who was skilled in warfare. 
With him leading the troops, 
Wu's army was still very powerful. What should be done?
summary_zh: 勾践通过赠送木料和美人削弱吴国国力，但担忧吴国大将军伍子胥的军事实力，思考应对之策。

page_text_ocr_zh:
勾践派人给吴国的大臣伯嚭送了几大箱金银珠宝。这伯嚭正是伍子胥的死对头。

伯嚭收下财宝后，就悄悄对夫差说：‘大王，伍子胥手下军队多，人又狂妄傲慢，如果有一天他想当国君，大手一挥，咱们可打不过呀！不如，您赐一把宝剑试一试他，看他听不听您的话？’
夫差一听，立刻赐给伍子胥一把宝剑。伍子胥收到宝剑，知道吴王再也不相信自己了，就拔出宝剑刺向自己。
从此，吴国失去了一位英勇的将军。
page_text_en:
King Goujian sent a large amount of gold, silver, and jewels to Bo Pi, a minister of Wu. Bo Pi was the mortal enemy of Wu Zixu.

After receiving the treasures, Bo Pi secretly told King Fu Chai: 'Your Majesty, Wu Zixu commands many troops and is arrogant and conceited. If one day he tries to become king, with a single gesture, we would not be able to defeat him! Why not grant him a precious sword and test him, to see if he obeys you?'
Fu Chai, upon hearing this, immediately gave Wu Zixu a precious sword. When Wu Zixu received the sword, he realized the King no longer trusted him, and he drew the sword and stabbed himself.
From then on, the State of Wu lost a brave general.
summary_zh: 勾践派人贿赂吴国大臣伯嚭，伯嚭劝说吴王夫差赐剑给伍子胥以试探其忠诚，夫差照做，伍子胥自尽，吴国失去一位重要将军。

page_text_ocr_zh: 十二年后，勾践复仇的机会终于来了。 这年，夫差带着全国的精锐兵马北上， 争夺霸主之位去了。勾践趁机带兵攻打 兵力空虚的吴国。夫差来不及救援，只 好向越国求和。后来，吴国又赶上大旱， 国内一片混乱。勾践再次发起进攻，终 于将吴国一举攻破。勾践也成为春秋时 期最后一位霸主。勾践趁吴国混乱，抓住 时机打败了吴国。这就像 趁着别人家失火去抢劫，这种计策就叫" 趁火打劫"。
page_text_en: Twelve years later, the opportunity for Goujian's revenge finally came. That year, Fu Chai led the nation's elite troops north to compete for the title of overlord. Goujian seized the chance to attack Wu, whose forces were empty. Fu Chai could not come to the rescue and had to seek peace with Yue. Later, Wu suffered a great drought, causing chaos within the country. Goujian launched another offensive and finally defeated Wu in one fell swoop. Goujian became the last overlord of the Spring and Autumn period. Taking advantage of Wu's chaos, Goujian seized the opportunity to defeat them. This is like robbing someone's house while it's on fire. This strategy is called 'taking advantage of a fire to rob'.
summary_zh: 十二年后，勾践趁吴王夫差北上争霸、国内空虚且遭遇大旱之机，发动进攻，一举攻破吴国，最终成为春秋时期最后一位霸主。画面描绘了越军攻城的激烈战斗场景。
